$comment: Storage: Cloudflare R2 - lifecycle rules for Studio's R2 buckets (STORAGE_PROVIDER=r2).
The S3 equivalent is infra/s3-lifecycle.json; same file shape, same AWS SDK v3
PutBucketLifecycleConfiguration rule shape (R2 implements that operation).
Apply with: STORAGE_PROVIDER=r2 npx tsx scripts/ops/apply-s3-lifecycle.ts (dry-run diff) then --apply.
Lifecycle changes need an R2 token with Admin Read & Write (Workers R2 Storage Write), not the
app's Object Read & Write token: runbooks/r2-setup.md.
Validated in CI by src/lib/studio/ops/s3-lifecycle.test.ts (npm test).
R2 limits (developers.cloudflare.com/r2/buckets/object-lifecycles/): prefix filters only (no tag
filters), expiration after N days, abort incomplete multipart after N days, at most 1000 rules.
R2 has no bucket versioning, so there are no noncurrent-version or delete-marker rules.
Intermediates: R2 has no object tagging, so provider outputs are written under
and expire by that prefix after 30 days in the assets bucket.
No rule expires current objects under orgs/: completed uploads and renders must not expire.
Abandoned (PENDING) uploads are swept by the app (sweep-abandoned-uploads job), not by R2.
Renders are kept for the lifetime of the publication + 90 days: app logic, not lifecycle.
